review.checked:
Watched A-20 IG frame by frame as contact sheets and strips around every transition. Measured consecutive-frame diffs for all 600 frames, plus A-14 IG and 4:5. Every full-field change falls on a multiple of 15, apart from the designed transitions: drain f32-44, repaint f79-87, iris f131-134, 81-row landing f362, flood f378-381, M shrink f401, wind-up f588-593. No category beat is longer than 15 frames.

Things that are fine:
- Hook: the remap looks natural (n2-16 wide, replay n6-18 in the punch-in on f15, n18 held f28-29). «حلو…» slams on f3 and exits on f32-33.
- Source footage: phase correlation shows no camera jumps in k30-72, o0-44, c0-18 or c68-96.
- Burger: the settled bun sways at most 4 px. The backwards index jumps n71→n54 at f120 (porthole) and f240 (lens) are therefore invisible. The bun fall f219-224 is monotonic and accelerating. Burger B's landing across the cut, the bump and the push-in are clean.
- Lens entrances: the oud slide and the coffee pop are smooth.
- Holds: the band freezes (burger n72 f495-509, coffee n96 f569-587) are invisible on static products. Band seams are under 1 level.
- Flood: the luma ramp over f378-381 is smooth, with no step.
- Snap, burst and tagline timing match the spec.
- Dots: the typing phase is continuous across sections. The dots read as the same three dots through floor → jump → ش → offer → rows → flood → CTA wordmark → wind-up iris from its middle dot.
- Loop: f599 to f0 differs only by the typing dots (mean abs diff 0.065, both A-20 and A-14). The MP4 frames align with the PNGs (sampled f0, 15, 90, 135, 225, 450, 599).
- TikTok: TT differs from IG only on f453-591, and its CTA layout is clean. The A-14 wind-up is fine.

Not reported, as listed build decisions: no ghost dots, the floor drop at f45-50, 57 dots in 4:5, the 4:5 burst flying off the frame, burst dots below the tagline, perfume in the centre porthole.

Review sheets and crops are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-visitor-counter-api/1e0f8dbb-d731-5965-a898-07519c7bdbc3/scratchpad/rev_pic/ (ov_*.jpg, cta_in.jpg, a14_cta.jpg, iris.jpg, portdots.png, jumpline.png, mult.jpg, burgA.jpg, wind_glass.jpg, d20ig.txt). Scripts are in its tools/ folder.

The sheet /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-visitor-counter-api/1e0f8dbb-d731-5965-a898-07519c7bdbc3/scratchpad/rev_pic/sk/m1_cmp.jpg shows f133-136 looking like f0-3 with a different tag word, so it reads as a restart.
